parameters.content:
## WF-Batch — Generate Batch (fb-generate-batch)
On-demand only. The Dashboard 'Generate up to N' button (executive-gated, N capped at MAX_PER_GENERATION=7) POSTs { max } with the `x-webhook-secret: __N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET__` header. It ACKS IMMEDIATELY ({ ok, started }) via Respond (started), then runs the loop in the background; an invalid secret returns 401 via Respond (denied).

Select Slots picks up to `max` fb_content_plan rows (status='planned', plan_date>=today, no fb_posts row for that date), oldest first, pre-building each slot's generator prompt (all reads via this.helpers.httpRequest — no PostgREST fan-out). Loop Over Slots then runs WF1's generation per slot: Anthropic → image prompt → image → Decode Image → PUT upload to the PUBLIC fb-images bucket → insert fb_posts draft → mark plan 'generated' → bump subtopic, with a ~3s throttle. One GroupMe summary at the end (Execute Once).

NOTE (Strategist brief): Select Slots fills generator v2's brief placeholders from each slot's APPROVED brief (fb_content_plan.brief_status='approved') when present, else image-only defaults; any leftover {{...}} token is stripped. media_type forced to image / video_concept empty until the video branch lands.

IMAGE UPLOAD (do not regress): use the two-node Decode Image (prepareBinaryData) → Upload to fb-images (HTTP node, contentType=binaryData) path. Do NOT switch to an in-memory this.helpers.httpRequest({ body: buffer }) upload — this n8n build serializes the Buffer to {"type":"Buffer",...} text (whether json is true OR false) and stores a bloated, non-rendering file.

Replace `YOUR_SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY` and `__...__` placeholders on import. Keep `active:false` in the committed copy.
